definitions.explanation: A dream that appears to predict or foresee a future event.

examples.japanese: {予知夢|よちむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。

examples.english: I feel like I saw that accident in a prophetic dream.

examples.japanese: {予知夢|よちむ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予言|よげん}できる→予言する：25500_yogensuru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{科学的|かがくてき}→科学的：05677_kagakuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Whether precognitive dreams can truly predict the future has not been scientifically proven.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{予知|よち}→予知：19829_yochi⟧ (foreknowledge, premonition) + {夢|む} (dream). A popular topic in Japanese culture, frequently appearing in manga, anime, and supernatural discussions. The concept is widely discussed online and in entertainment, even by people who don't literally believe in it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予知夢|よちむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to have a precognitive dream
- {予知夢|よちむ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: a precognitive dream comes true
- {予知夢|よちむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧: to believe in precognitive dreams

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{予知|よち}→予知：19829_yochi⟧: foreknowledge, premonition
- ⟦{正夢|まさゆめ}→正夢：18248_masayume⟧: a dream that comes true — slightly different; refers to any dream that happens to match reality
- {逆夢|さかゆめ}: a dream whose opposite comes true
- ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧: premonition, gut feeling — an intuitive warning, not necessarily through dreams

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{正夢|まさゆめ}→正夢：18248_masayume⟧: dream that comes true — retrospective; realized after the event happens
- ⟦{悪夢|あくむ}→悪夢：12620_akumu⟧: nightmare — a bad dream, not necessarily predictive
